Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Annexure I to DPMF-8 Ordnance Factory Hospital OEFC, Kanpur Type-B Ambulance Services In addition to General Terms & Conditions of GeM Spec No. 196/07/OFHOEFC/Ambulance/GeM/2026-27, Dt.02/09/2026 1.0 BRIEF INTRODUCTION:Ordnance Factory Hospital OEFC (OFHOEFC) Kanpur intends to hire 01 Nos. of T ype-B AC Ambulance Service -Single Stretcher-Regular Van including Driver (Whole Job) on regular basis fo r 24x7. The job involves the provision of the services of the said ambulances along with drivers as specified in the tender document. 2.0 GENERAL: 2.1 Tenderers are advised to study carefully the various clauses contained in the Terms and conditions be fore submitting their bids. The tenders shall be in two bids, technical and Price bids. Only the vendors quali

fied in the technical bid shall be qualified for Price bid. 2.2 Because provision of the Ambulance service is exigent in nature, prospective bidders shall en- sure tha t they are thorough with all the requirements of the buyer. 2.3 The driver of the Ambulance shall carry all the statutory documents and shall produce the same to loca l authority when asked. The Contractee shall in no case be field responsible for failure to produce the statu tory documents i.e. the contractee shall remain indemnified at all times in case a violation of statutory obli gation bv the contractor or the drivers engaged bv them. 3.0 SCOPE OF WORK: This whole job contract is for supply of 01 (One) Type B AC ambulance Service-Single Stretcher-Regular Va n including Driver (Whole Job) on regular basis for 24x7. to Ordnance Factory Hospital OEFC (OFH-OEFC), Kanpur. The job involves provision of ambulance vehicle with specified equipment, communication faciliti es and driver as per the specifications given below. Punctuality, reliability and commitment are the essenc e of this contract. 4.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT: The contract shall be for a period of 02 months round the clock 24x7 including holidays and Sundays from the date specified (Date of commencement) in the Supply Order. The Contract can be foreclosed/terminated by Competent Authority of DFUKN without any assigning any reason thereof. 5.0 PRE-QUALIFICATION: 5.1 EMD is exempted since the bid Value is less than Rs 5 Lakhs. 5.2 The bidding firm should either have the required type and number of Ambulances (as mentioned abov e) in his own name/proprietorship should have valid legal agreement with owner (if ambulances are not o wned by the bidder) for supply of the said services as per the contract and shall submit the documentary p roof with the technical bid. 5.3 The bidder must have successfully executed / completed similar services for the last three years i.e. th e current financial year and the last three (03) financial years (ending month of March prior to the bid open ing):- A. Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimated cost. Or B. Two similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of the estimated cost. Or C. One similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the estimated cost. 5.4 The bidders’ average annual turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous fi nancial years should be at least 30% of the estimated cost Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accounta nt indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 03 years old, the average turnover in respect of the c ompleted financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criterion. 5.5 Income Tax returns (of the firm/proprietor as the case may be) for the last 03 financial years should be submitted. 5.6 The bidder should submit copy of GST registration certificate and PAN of the proprietor and firm/proprie tor (as the case may be). 5.7 Exemption as per DoE letter no. F.20/2/2014-PPD(Pt.), dated 25.07.2017 (MSME firms having UDYAM re gistration with SERVICES as major activity under NIC code 86909 & Start Up certificate with Healthcare or Emergency Services). 6.0 QUOTATION:- The firm should quote the rate for 01 ambulance as follows: ó.1 Per month ambulance hiring cost. ó.2 No separate payment will be made for night stay. 6.3 Charges for extra KM running per month will be calculated as follows: Charges for extra KM in a month = (Actual cumulative running of 01 ambulances in a month — 1500KM X Rs 12/Km (Rs 12 per KM is the rate for each KM run in a month beyond the period of contract (if applicable ). 7.0 PAYMENT TERMS:- 7.1 No escalation of rate/s shall be permitted on any grounds during the currency of the contract. 7.2 The payment shall be made on monthly basis. 7.3 The payment shall be made to the contractor on monthly basis within 30 days of submission of pre-rec eipted contractor's bill in the following month. The bill shall be supported by:- a) Trip sheets/ log book duly signed by the medical officers. b) Job completion Certificate duly signed by Medical Officer-in-charge of ambulance ser- vices, OFHOEFC, K anpur. c) Road tax clearance (if applicable) would be required for executing the work order. Road Tax clearance w

ould be mandatory for release of payment to the firm after successful completion of the services. d) Penalty to be imposed as per GeM Service Level Agreement of contract. 8.0 TERMINATION AND EXTENSION OF CONTRACT:- 8.1 In case of poor performance of the vendor, the CFA or DDG/DFUKN reserves the right to short close or c ancel the contract at any time, upon issue of performance notices by the user and exhaustion of measures as per GeM GTC & SLA. 8.2 CFA or DDG/DFUKN reserves the right to extend the tenure of the contract by Nil (Option clause) at the existing rates and terms and conditions and the contractor has to abide by the same. 8.3 The Contract can also be foreclosed/terminated by Competent Authority of DFUKN without any assigni ng any reason thereof. 9.0 WORK SPECIFICATIONS:- 9.1 The ambulance vehicle/s shall be made available at Ordnance Factory Hospital OEFC, Kanpur for 24 ho urs period on all days including holidays/all working days. 9.2 The ambulance shall carry patients and attendants accompanying the patients as per the orders of Me dical Officers or authorized staff as shall be specified by Medical Officer-in-charge. 9.3 The ambulance vehicle with a driver should be prepared to overstay beyond the above mentioned peri od whenever required. 9.4 The approximate mileage will be 50Km per day or 1500km per month. The mileage run shall be calcul ated at the end of the each month as in clause 6.3. 9.5 The mileage will count only when the vehicle is 'IN' at OFHOEFC, Kanpur. Only duties ordered by hospit al authorities will count towards mileage. Any mileage should be clearly justified in the logbook by duties ordered by authorized Medical Officer. The mileage should be by the usual route and should be reasonable and justified should be fully justified and countersigned by Medical Officer ordering the duty. 9.6 A separate log book shall be maintained by the driver. It is the responsibility of the drivers to ensure th at the logbook is completed after each trip and signed by the Medical Officer ordering the movement of th e ambulance. 9.7 The vehicle (s) must not carry any person other than the person authorized by the Medical Officer orde ring the movement of the ambulance. 9.8 Contractor shall carry out work directly. Contractor is not allowed to carry out whole or part of the work through subcontract/s. 9.9 The ambulance vehicle may be utilized for hospital related official works in the interest of the hospital and patients. 10.0 CONTINGENCY ARRANGEMENTS: The contractor should have contingency arrangements to meet eve nts that may cause disruption in service like absenteeism, ambulance breakdown, bandh/strike call etc. 11.0 SPECIFICATIONS OF AMBULANCE VEHICLE: 11.1 Ambulance vehicle provided shall be Type B Ambulance Patient Transport Vehicle as specified in GeM portal, preferably- white colour. 11.2 The ambulance vehicle should be in perfect running condition. 11.3 The ambulance vehicle should be air conditioned. 11.4 The ambulance vehicle will be provided with the following by the contractor: a) One foldable stretcher. b) First aid box. c) Fans two Nos. in patient carrying compartment. d) Seats for attendant/s in the patient carrying compartment. e) Standard fittings required for ambulance vehicle such as siren, light, signage etc. 11.5 The ambulance vehicle should have provisions for the following: a) Carrying one patient in lying condition. b) Carrying one full Oxygen Cylinder. c) Drinking water and, Hanging IV fluids. d) Carrying Emergency equipment. e) Board displayed on the front: "ON DUTY ORDNANCE FACTORY HOSPITAL OEFC, Ministry Of Defence " 11.6 The ambulance vehicle shall have to be properly serviced and be maintained in perfect running cond ition and cleaned by the contractor throughout the period of the contract. 11.7 Ambulance vehicle should have been manufactured/fabricated originally as ambulance and should n ot have been converted to ambulance from some other vehicle. 11.8 Ambulance vehicle should not have been converted to run on fuel other than its original manufactur e specification. 11.9 Driver must carry all relevant and valid documents required by the law. 11.10 The ambulance vehicle should carry sufficient fuel at all times for minimum 24 hrs running

11.11 The ambulance vehicle must have a set of standard tools, essential spares, accessories and a Stepn ey in good condition as required for attending breakdown immediately. 12. DRIVERS: 12.1 The Drivers inter-alia should have a valid professional driving license as per relevant Motor Vehicles Act and always carry the same while on duty. 12.2 The drivers should be able to read the requisition slip and fill up the log book in English/Hindi. 12.3 The driver should have thorough knowledge of the routes and roads, locations of hospitals of Kanpur. 12.4 The drivers should possess good health, good manners, and good character. They should be respons ible, reliable, punctual and amenable to discipline. They should be polite and exhibit good manners with ho spital authorities, staff, patients and visitors. 12.5 The drivers should wear suitable clean uniform. 12.6 Drivers should not be under the influence of alcohol or other intoxicating substances while on duty. 12.7 Drivers should be conversant with basic first aid procedures. 12.8 The drivers shall carry a mobile phone to be provided by the contractor at all times while on duty for communication. 12.9 The drivers shall assist in shifting the patient in stretcher etc. 12.10 At the beginning of the contract, Contractor shall provide a panel of drivers proposed to be employe d by him along with: a) Character Certificates from two Gazetted Officers, b) Police Verification Report within 2 weeks from date of SO, c) Photographs-3 numbers. 10.11 Only drivers from the panel shall be allowed to work. Any additions and deletions to the panel shoul d have the prior permission of the Medical Officer-in-charge of ambulance services. 12.12 The contractor shall maintain sufficient additional drivers to meet weekly off and leave requirement s. 13.0 CONSEQUENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: 13.1 The Driver of ambulance shall carry all the statutory documents to be produced to local authority wh en asked. The contractee shall in no case be held responsible for failure to produce the statutory documen ts. 13.2 The contractor shall solely be responsible for any accident that may occur while executing the contra ct. 13.3 If the ambulance vehicle breaks down during duty or is not available due to any reason such as servi cing, an alternate ambulance vehicle of same specification shall immediately be provided by the contracto r. The part trip will not count towards mileage (billing). 13.4 In case of failure to provide alternate ambulance vehicle in case of breakdown, proportionate deducti on shall be made from the contractor's bill. 13.5 In case of late reporting, deduction shall be made from the contractor's bill at the rates applicable fo r overstay. 13.6 The vehicle(s) when not sent anywhere on duty shall have to be parked only at place(s) approved b y the Medical officer-in-charge. If the vehicle or the driver is not available at such approved parking place(s ), it shall be treated as absent. 13.7 No movement of the vehicle shall be allowed for any purpose other than that allowed by the author ized Medical Officers and staff. Any such unauthorized movement shall not be considered for payment and the ambulance shall be considered to be absent during the related period. 13.8 The odometer of the vehicle must always be in good and correctly working order, failing which the vehicle shall be treated as absent till the same is set right. 13.9 The contractor shall bear the complete responsibility of conduct and punctuality of the drivers emp loyed by him. The contractor shall remain fully responsible for any undesirable incidence/situation caused /created by their conduct/activities. 13.10 If a driver is a found unsuitable for the work by Medical Officer-in-charge, OFH/OEFC, Kanpur due to misconduct/negligence of duty / unsafe act/ being under influence alcohol/violation of any norms or instruc tions or any other reason, the person shall be replaced by the contractor immediately on being informed t o that effect 13.11 The contractor will not permit his employees to participate in any trade union activities or agitation in the premises. All demands/disputes of drivers engaged by the contractor or their Union will have to be s ettled by the contractor himself. 13.12 The contractor shall also be liable for any expenses, loss or damage which OEFC / Hospital may su stain during execution of the job/ by contractor's employees. The same shall be recovered from the contra ctor. 14.0 SAFETY AND SECURITY: The contractor shall be responsible for his employees observing all the sec urity and safety regulations/instructions as may be issued by the factory and hospital from time to time. 15.0 PERFORMANCE EVALUATION:

15.1 Contractor or his authorised representative will contact the Medical Officer /staff in-charge ambula nce services once a week for review of the work done. 15.2 A complaint register shall be maintained at the hospital OFHOEFC to record any complaint on perfo rmance. The complaints shall be acted upon and settled speedily. 16.0 STATUTORY CONDITIONS: The contractor shall abide by and comply with provisions of all the Acts a nd Rules by Central and State Govt as applicable from time to time in respect of the contracted work and a ll staffs employed by him. 17.0 ARBITRATION: All the disputes and differences arising out of and in anyway touching and concernin g this contract (Except for which specific provisions have been made herein) shall be referred to sole arbit rator to be appointed by the Director General, Directorate of Ordnance (Coordination & Services). The arbit rator so appointed shall be a government servant who had not dealt with the matters related to this contra ct and in the course of his duties had not expressed on all or any of the matter in dispute. The venue of the arbitration will be at Kanpur. The award of the arbitrator so appointed shall be final and binding on the part ies to this contract subject to the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996 as amended from t ime to time. 18.0 Any dispute between the buyer and seller shall subject to the jurisdiction of Kanpur Nagar only. .
